verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਨਾਂ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਸਾਧੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: chhia rutee kar saadhanaa(n) chhia dharasan saadhai gurmatee|

en.bdb: Attaining spiritual discipline through the six seasons, the gurmukh assimilates even the six philosophies.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਰਸ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਰਾਗ ਰਾਗਣੀ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: chhia ras rasanaa saadh kai raag raaganee bhai bhagatee|

en.bdb: He conquers the six tastes (sour, sweet, astringent, bitter, tart and saltish) of the tongue and along with six musical measures and their consorts surrenders with full devotions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਚਿਰਜੀਵੀ ਛਿਅ ਜਤੀ ਚੱਕ੍ਰਵਰਤਿ ਛਿਅ ਸਾਧਿ ਜੁਗਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: chhia chirajeevee chhia jatee cha'kravarat chhia saadh jugatee|

en.bdb: He understands and accomplishes the ways of life of six immortal ones, six yatis (ascetics)  and six yogic chakras.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਛਿਅ ਕਰਮ ਜਿਣਿ ਛਿਆ ਗੁਰਾਂ ਗੁਰ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਿਰਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: chhia saasatr chhia karam jin chhiaa guraa(n) gur surat niratee|

en.bdb: Conquering the six codes of conduct and the six philosophies, he cultivates friendship with the six gurus (teachers of these philosophies).

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਵਰਤਾਰੇ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਛਿਅ ਛਕ ਛਤੀ ਪਵਣ ਪਰਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: chhia varataare saadh kai chhia chhak chhatee pavan paratee|

en.bdb: He turns his face from the five external organs plus one internal organ, the mind, and their attendant thirty six kinds of hypocrisies.
Reaching the holy congregation the consciousness of a gurmukh gets absorbed in the Word of the Guru.
